Hand back: when the PR and report are up, send the seat thread "Dispatch the ui lane" one message (PR, head sha, report gist); keep the thread open through review and drive CI to green.

### Ruling (cannot be re-ruled)

Triage first grade 6407890835 (2026-10-24): "delete the vestigial `(schema as any)` reads in `ListView` / `ObjectView` / `ObjectGrid` … For `rowActionDefs`, go spec-first (AGENTS #0.1): it either becomes a spec card or the read stops." ⛔ Out of scope until the maintainer names it: `no-explicit-any: 'error'`. Binding on top, in the code itself: the objectui#5097 maintainer ruling (2026-08-18, 「同意」) fixed 27 `OBJECT_VIEW_HOST_COMPOSITION_KEYS` (`ui/packages/plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx:958`) as HOST-COMPOSITION surface: "⛔ do not delete a read as a tidy-up — a deleted read silently blanks a stored app-shell document." "Vestigial" therefore means a cast on a key the type already declares, never one of those 27 reads.

### PM mechanism assumptions (measure on `origin/main` `9dec0545`; disproof welcome)

- `ObjectView.tsx` has 30 node reads in the `renderListView` fence (comment at `:2958`): 27 exempt, three on declared `ObjectViewSchema` members. By elimination those three are `data` (`:3113`), `navigation` (`:3115`) and `searchableFields` (`:3118`). Drop their cast (`schema.data` etc.), and keep the fence comment's counts true. `objectViewHostSurface.test.tsx` re-derives the fence's read set by name and `object-view-unmirrored-keys-7779.test.ts` (`@object-ui/types`) censuses the file; run both, and adjust a pin only where it counted a cast that no longer exists.
- `ObjectGrid.tsx` (`ui/packages/plugin-grid`) has two reads. `rowActionDefs` (`:949`) is declared on the data-table surface (`ui/packages/types/src/data-display.ts:1476`) but not on the grid's schema type. `hideRowHeightToggle` (`:3395`) is declared nowhere in `ui/packages/types/src` or `packages/spec/src`. For each, measure whether any producer writes it onto an object-grid node (examples, apps, platform-objects, ListView/ObjectView hand-offs). With a producer, it is a spec gap: file nothing yourself, report it under `out_of_scope_findings` with the producer `file:line`, and leave the read. With no producer, the read stops, and a test pins that the grid ignores it.
- Any other `(schema as any)` read in these two files outside the fence follows the same test: declared ⇒ drop the cast; undeclared ⇒ producer check as above.

### Scope

File surface: `ui/packages/plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx`, `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx`, and their tests/pins. ⛔ `ListView.tsx` is out: it is in seat 2's package and open PR #27206 (another project, `options` bag retirement) rewrites it. ⛔ No ESLint rule change. Ablation: for any read you stop, restoring it turns the new test red. Stay under 300 changed lines.

Serial: PR #27206 (draft) also edits `ObjectView.tsx` (hunks near `:227`, `:2058–2105`, `:3031–3043`). Keep clear of those lines, merge `origin/main` before your gates, and if #27206 lands first, merge again and re-run the plugin-view tests.

### Tier

Quote `dispatch-gates --tier` on your surface. Expected none. `TIER_DEFAULT`, effort `medium`. `Clause-②: no` (a cast removal on a declared key changes no type; a stopped read on an undeclared key with no producer narrows nothing authored), `Metadata-protocol: none`. `@object-ui/plugin-view` / `plugin-grid` are published: a patch changeset in the root `.changeset/` if behaviour changes, otherwise `skip-changeset` with the reason. The PR says `Part of #25918` (ListView and the lint rule stay open).
